Title: Wells Tech & Data Engineer
Description: Date: 17 Nov 2026 Location: Mexico City, MX Advertised Salary: Competitive Onshore/Offshore: Working arrangement: Full Time Since its creation in 2014, Harbour has grown to become one of the world’s largest and most geographically diverse independent oil and gas companies. Today, Harbour is producing between 475,000 and 485,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day with significant production in Norway, the UK, Germany, Argentina and North Africa. Harbour benefits from competitive operating costs and resilient margins, and a broad set of growth options including near-infrastructure opportunities in Norway, unconventional scalable opportunities in Argentina and conventional offshore projects in Mexico and Indonesia. With low GHG emissions intensity and a leading CO2 storage position in Europe, Harbour remains committed to producing oil and gas safely and responsibly to help meet the world’s energy needs. Harbour is headquartered in London with approximately 5,000 staff and contractors across its operations and offices. Ours is an inclusive workplace where individuals can bring their whole selves to their job and feel recognised for the value they add. We are committed to creating a genuinely inclusive and supportive working environment to ensure everyone has a positive experience at work. At Harbour Energy, we aim to recruit, retain and promote our people based on their unique skills, regardless of race, gender or background. We need excellent people to help shape and develop the future of our company. Could this be you? If so, we want to hear from you. Purpose of Role: Combine Wells engineering knowledge with data engineering, analytics, automation and artificial intelligence to improve how wells are planned, delivered and evaluated. Act as the technical bridge between Wells teams, Operations, Subsurface, HSES, IT/Data functions and technology providers, converting operational needs into secure, practical and maintainable digital solutions. Improve the quality, accessibility and use of Wells data to strengthen safety, technical assurance, performance, decision-making, knowledge retention and continuous improvement across projects. Critical Responsibilities (MAE/MATTE/HSES*): Ensuring that all activities are carried out in a safe manner complying with all regulatory requirements, legislation and Harbour Energy HSES Procedures. Ensure digital, data, AI and real-time solutions support and do not compromise Wells technical assurance, well control, well integrity, barrier management or Management of Change processes. Ensure the integrity, availability, traceability and security of safety-critical Wells data, including appropriate validation, access controls and protection against unauthorized modification or loss. Ensure AI, analytics and automated recommendations affecting safety-critical activities are validated by competent Wells personnel, with appropriate human oversight before operational use. Identify and manage digital, data and cybersecurity risks that could affect Well control, barrier status, operational decision-making or other MAE/MATTE prevention measures. Support relevant HAZID, HAZOP, DWOP, risk assessment and MoC activities where digital systems, real-time data, automation or AI could introduce, modify or mitigate operational risks. Ensure appropriate contingency and fallback arrangements are established for loss, corruption or unavailability of critical data, communications or digital systems. Promote a strong HSES and data-safety culture, recognising that inaccurate, unavailable, unsecured or incorrectly interpreted Wells data can contribute to operational and process-safety risk. Exercise and promote Stop Work Authority where digital/data integrity or system reliability could compromise safe Wells operations. Ethics and Compliance Responsibilities: Ensure that all activities and behaviours are carried out in accordance with Harbour Energy’s Ethics and Compliance Policies and Procedures, and to complete any compulsory compliance training as required. Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence: Wells Data Management: Maintain and improve the quality, consistency, taxonomy, traceability and accessibility of drilling, completions, intervention and performance data. Integrate and structure information from WellView, daily drilling reports, End of Well Reports, drilling programmes, lessons learned, NPT/ILOT records and real-time data sources. Develop data-quality controls and support a reliable single source of truth for Wells information. Analytics & Performance: Develop and maintain dashboards, automated reporting and benchmarking for cost, schedule, ROP, flat time, connection time, tripping, NPT/ILOT and drilling dysfunction. Translate data into clear engineering insights, trends and recommendations for project and leadership reviews. Digitalisation & Automation: Identify manual or repetitive workflows and develop scalable solutions using Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Python, SQL or other approved tools. Support digital workflows for engineering assurance, reporting, action tracking, knowledge management and cross-project collaboration. AI & Advanced Technology: Develop responsible applications of AI and Generative AI for offset-well analysis, document interrogation, lessons learned, reporting, knowledge retrieval and engineering decision support. Evaluate emerging Wells software, drilling analytics, real-time operations and automation solutions; support pilots, technical evaluations and business cases. Engineering & Stakeholder Support: Work with drilling, completions, interventions and well planning engineers to define requirements and convert operational problems into practical data or technology solutions. Coordinate interfaces with IT/Data teams, Subsurface, Operations, HSES, Supply Chain, HQ, contractors and technology vendors. Provide user guidance, documentation and adoption support to ensure solutions are sustainable and deliver measurable value. Critical Skills*, Qualifications, Experience, etc.: Technical Skills Strong technical knowledge of Wells/drilling process, understanding of wells terminology, data and performance measures, including NPT/ILOT, time analysis and operational reporting. Strong capability in data analysis and visualisation, preferably Microsoft Power BI and advanced Excel. Ability to define data-quality rules, reconcile multiple sources and communicate uncertainty, limitations and assumptions. Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Python, SQL, APIs, data models and cloud/data architecture awareness. Familiarity with WellView, Landmark, Oliasoft, real-time drilling platforms, drilling automation or predictive analytics. Hands-on application of AI or Generative AI in controlled engineering workflows, with awareness of cybersecurity, data privacy and responsible-AI requirements. Non-Technical Skills: Practical problem-solving and ability to translate engineering requirements into maintainable digital solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across Wells, field, IT/Data and vendor teams. Proactively identifies opportunities to improve Wells engineering and operations through data, digitalisation, automation and AI, with a clear focus on safety, efficiency and measurable value Collaborative and credible with experienced Wells professionals; able to own delivery from problem definition through implementation and adoption. Organised and adaptable, capable of supporting projects and priorities while maintaining technical integrity. Professional Experience: Relevant upstream oil and gas experience with demonstrated understanding of Wells engineering, drilling operations or well delivery workflows. Approximately 7-10 years of relevant experience in drilling and well engineering and digital solutions combined. Practical experience working with engineering or operational datasets and delivering analytics, dashboards, applications or automated workflows. Operator, offshore, exploration and appraisal, real-time drilling data or multi-project experience. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum, Drilling, or Mechanical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline. Language: Proficient English, spoken and written. Spanish is an advantage. Harbour Principles and Values: Strong alignment with and commitment to the core values and behaviours of Harbour Energy. Inclusive recruitment is a vital part of our diversity, equity and inclusion strategy. Whatever your background, if you feel you need an adjustment during our selection process to suit your needs, please let us know, and we will be happy to help. For further information or support on any of these points, please reach out to us at careers@harbourenergy.com

Title: Marketplace Operations Intern

Growth We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow. Diversity and Inclusion Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate. Title: Lead Analytics Engineer, Data Governance & Platform
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform. About Analytics At LawnStarter We're a small, senior analytics team supporting the entire company: product, marketing, operations, and finance all run on the data we serve. The foundation is solid. A centralized Redshift data warehouse holds all source data, modeled in dbt and orchestrated by Airflow, with Segment feeding event data in. You won't be stitching scattered sources together. The platform exists, and your job is to make it trustworthy and keep it that way. We're mid-migration to Lightdash as our single BI platform, replacing Tableau and Metabase. Data governance is becoming a dedicated function here. You'll be its first dedicated owner, building it alongside the Data Director. The Role You'll own LawnStarter's data governance area and build it: the person who turns the governance agenda into working systems (monitors, checks, lineage, metric definitions, tracking standards) with your own hands. You'll grow the function together with the Data Director, at the pace demand and impact call for. If you want it and the skills are there, you could become its manager one day. "Lead" here means technical weight first. You're the reference the analysts turn to when a pipeline misbehaves, a metric definition gets contentious, or an event's data looks wrong, and the example that raises the bar for how governance work gets done. As the function grows, your leadership can widen with it. What Makes This Role Different Build, don't chase. Your job is the machinery that catches data problems before stakeholders do: automation and monitors, not manual firefighting Whole-stack surface. Source data to pipelines to dashboards and ML models. Your work touches the entire chain, not one slice of it A live migration to shape. Lightdash is landing now, and the semantic layer just shipped for our most critical metrics. You'll do the defining, mapping, and tidying work that decides whether they stay trustworthy An area to grow. Governance doesn't have a fixed shape here yet. The guardrails exist. You're the person who runs them and catches what they miss. Turn business needs into a data roadmap Every area of the company wants something from data, and today those asks reach the Analytics team as a stream of interruptions. Title: Delivery Pod Lead, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Signed Deals Into Working Data Foundations Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. For enterprise customers, the data foundation runs either on our managed ClickHouse stack or warehouse-native inside the customer's own Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. The hard problem Every enterprise customer is different, but our AI must reason the same way wherever the data lives. Your team turns messy, unique customer data into a consistent data foundation and ML, fast, and you decide how each delivery gets done. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. What You'll Do Lead and grow a small team of data and ML engineers who will be delivering the data foundation. Review solution designs and proof-of-concept scopes before they reach customers, and decide what can be delivered and how. Own each delivery after signature: staff it with the right engineers, and own its plan, timeline and quality. Stay hands-on in architecture, data discovery, canonical modeling, semantic layers, ETL and ELT orchestration across customer and Hilbert environments, secure cloud integration, and reviews of feature and model work. Help build our Data Discovery Agent, which will analyze customer data, suggest mappings and scaffold first pipelines, and bring it into your team's work as it matures. Be the main technical contact for our customers' engineering teams. Work with product engineering to turn repeated delivery work into product, and bring new industries and stacks to them early. Help our sales engineers learn the delivery side and engineering capabilities. Who You Are The player-coach: you lead engineers and still design, write and review the hard parts yourself. The translator: you earn a customer data architect's trust quickly and turn the logic of their systems into something our reasoning engine understands. The pilot: you're excited to help build AI agents that take on the heavy lifting of discovery and pipeline scaffolding. The systems thinker: you see delivery as a system, not a series of projects. You design the processes, standards, reusable patterns and automation that let a small team handle very different environments without slowing down or cutting corners. Extensive field experience in data engineering, data architecture or ML engineering, ideally from engineering consultancy or B2B delivery of data and ML projects, including leading engineers on customer projects. Hands-on delivery on Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and comfort with modern stacks such as Dagster, Airbyte, ClickHouse and Cube. Working knowledge of cloud security and system integration on AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish, for working with customers across the region. Nice to have Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Regulated industry consultancy experience Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to our Senior Leader for Forward Deployed Engineering. The role is based in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, or Peru with occasional visits to our largest customers in the North and South America. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Title: Forward Deployed Growth Partner, LATAM
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Forward Deployed Growth Engineers are a new, dedicated customer team at Hilbert, sitting in our Foundations Tribe. You'll work hand in hand with our Growth Science and Product teams, who own the product's logic, models and playbooks, and take that expertise into every customer, from the first meeting to the moment Hilbert is running their growth. What the role is This is customer success delivered with growth expertise. You'll join each of your accounts as soon as the lead comes in. You'll help shape the use cases during the sales cycle and keep owning the account through deployment and live usage. You own two commercial outcomes: proof-of-concept conversion and existing account revenue growth . We also measure time to first value, sustained product adoption and the share of routine customer needs you handle independently. Two things make this role different from most customer success jobs. First, you're forward-deployed: you'll travel with our GTM team around 50% of the time, sit in the room with our customers' leadership, and become the person they call when they want to move faster. Second, you're a growth operator, not a ticket handler: our customers buy growth, and you'll help them own their use cases in Hilbert, from paid media, CRM and retention to discounts, merchandising and demand forecasting, and read the results back with them . You are expected to develop a deep understanding of Hilbert’s capabilities, communicate clearly and effectively with customers, and proactively manage customer relationships to maximize the value delivered to every customer. You'll be part of the first cohort of this team, reporting to the Head of Forward Deployed Growth in our Foundations Tribe and working day to day with the GTM team and delivery engineering pod in your region. You'll learn our data sources, deployment methods and the problems our customers bring us alongside our Growth Science, Product and data teams, and you'll handle most routine customer needs independently. When an account needs deeper expertise, you'll bring in our subject-matter experts and turn what you learn into answers, case studies and examples the whole team reuses. What you'll do Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end: get assigned as soon as a lead comes in, shape the use cases with GTM and sales engineering through close, and stay accountable for onboarding coordination, customer follow-ups and blocker tracking. Convert pilots into long-term partnerships: define success criteria with the customer up front, keep the proof of concept on track, and make the business case for expansion with numbers you can defend. Grow account revenue: find the next highest-impact use case inside each customer and turn it into new scope. Be the customer's trusted growth advisor: lead demos and working sessions, help customers put agreed use cases into practice, train their teams, review results, and identify what is blocking adoption. Drive real business transformation: go beyond usage and make sure the results change how the customer's business runs. Get the customer's data in: scope the data each use case needs, agree with their data team how it reaches Hilbert, and run the timeline with our data engineers until it is usable. Do it again whenever a new use case needs new data. Capture how each customer measures their business: their KPIs, definitions and business rules, set up in Hilbert so every answer matches their numbers. Manage every stakeholder: from the C-level sponsor to the marketing, growth and data teams who use Hilbert every day, and keep them aligned as the account grows. Build rapport in person: travel with our GTM team around 50% of the time, shadow and then lead customer sessions, and know the product better than anyone else in the room. Cover most customer needs yourself, and know when to escalate: you are expected to handle around 80% of customer needs independently from the very first assignment, building toward the capability to cover 95% of everything a customer brings. For everything else, engage our Growth Science, Product, and Data teams efficiently by providing clear customer context, business impact, relevant evidence, and what you have already investigated. Respect their time by minimizing unnecessary meetings and prioritizing clear, asynchronous communication. Own the follow-up, keep the customer informed, and ensure key learnings feed into the product roadmap. Expand across departments and use cases: map which other teams (paid media, CRM, merchandising, pricing, finance) can run their decisions on Hilbert, find the next highest-impact use case in each, and turn it into new scope. Embed Hilbert into activation surfaces: connect Hilbert’s outputs to the tools where the customer’s teams already act, from ad platforms and CRM/CDP to promo, merchandising and planning systems, so every insight flows straight into execution and becomes part of the daily workflow. Join GTM funnel reviews: take part in the regular funnel reviews with the GTM team, and know which leads are coming to you next. Grow the shared library: add answers, case studies and customer examples, so expert guidance becomes something the whole team reuses. What you bring Around 5 to 8 years of experience: an engineering or natural sciences background, followed by an analytical role in management consulting or a similar setting; pure customer success leaders with a strong analytical edge are also welcome. Strongly analytical: you write SQL and understand customer data sources, key business definitions, data coverage and freshness, and the meaning and limitations of model outputs well enough to explain them and investigate routine questions. You can build a business case and present it to a CFO or CMO. Driven by real business transformation: insight isn't enough until it changes how the customer's business runs. Continuous learning: you don't know insurance or grocery yet, and you'll figure it out fast. You're a problem solver who hacks most of the job yourself and knows exactly who to bring in for the rest. Excellent with customers: polished and high-energy, at ease in every customer conversation from small talk to the boardroom, credible with senior stakeholders, and able to build relationships that outlast a single project. Strong stakeholder management is a must: you navigate complex organizations and keep senior and day-to-day stakeholders aligned. Happy to travel often across your region, around 50% of the time and sometimes to a different customer city every week, and to work with an owner's mindset in a fast-moving startup. Fluent in English and Spanish. Nice to have: deep vertical expertise in retail, grocery, or financial services, or existing relationships with enterprise B2C companies. Portuguese is a plus. Reporting and location You report to the Head of Forward Deployed Growth and work closely with our GTM leadership in Latin America, as the growth counterpart to the region’s GTM team. You’re on the move with GTM, joining new leads and customer meetings from the first conversation. Our Growth Science and Product teams own the product’s logic, models and playbooks, train you on them and support you on the deepest problems, and our delivery engineering team builds and runs each deployment with you. You are based in Latin America, ideally Mexico City or Lima. The role may start remotely while we build Hilbert’s regional presence, with travel to customers across the region of around 50 percent, and relocation within Latin America may be needed as our hub takes shape. Compensation Base salary, plus variable pay tied to performance and the revenue you help drive (proof-of-concept conversion, renewals and expansion), plus equity. Details are shared in next steps. Interview process Recruiter screen, 30 minutes. GTM interview with the GTM leadership in Latin America, 30 minutes: a customer relationship you owned, from first meeting to live usage or expansion, and how you managed the stakeholders along the way. Hiring manager interview, 30 minutes: how you work with customers and with our Growth, Product and GTM teams. Growth case with our Growth team, 60 minutes: a real customer case, from the business problem and the data it needs to the use case, the success criteria and the business case for expansion. Team and final interviews: meet the people you’ll work with day to day, and our leadership. References: two from clients, one from a colleague you worked with on customer accounts. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. On top of that, here’s how we take care of our team: Work from anywhere. Two weeks a year to take your laptop somewhere new, whether that’s a beach in Mallorca or your family’s kitchen table. Title: Forward Deployed Consultant

Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures. Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request. Working knowledge of integration platforms (make.com, Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus. Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience. Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries. Detail-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once. Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt. Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time. BA or BS degree preferred.
